item.title: Kenya Ebola Quarantine
item.description:
• Summary: A Kenyan court has suspended a government plan to establish a quarantine facility for Americans amid the ongoing Ebola outbreak. The legal decision raises questions about public health measures and international cooperation in response to the infectious disease threat.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: Ebola Vaccines
item.description:
• Summary: This article examines the current landscape of vaccines available to curb the Ebola outbreak. It discusses the efficacy and deployment of approved vaccines such as Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) and other investigational candidates, highlighting the challenges in outbreak control and vaccine logistics.
  • MoAs: Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV): A live attenuated recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus vector expressing the Zaire ebolavirus glycoprotein, eliciting an immune response. Other investigational vaccines may include adenovirus-based vectors or other platforms targeting Ebola virus glycoproteins.
  • Sources: STAT News
